title: Acceptance: rendered sizes do not change when the scaler is retired
description:
What: before deleting tools/scale_css.py capture computed sizes (font-size, line-height, spacing, image box) for every role at 375, 820 and 1440 px in light and dark on Machines on Machines; after the switch to native tokens the same capture must match exactly. The capture becomes a permanent golden test.
Why: this is the proof that rebuilding at final size is a refactor, not a redesign.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Native tokens reproduce the scaled sizes
  Given the captured computed sizes from the scaled stylesheet
  When MoM builds on native tokens with the scaler removed
  Then every captured size is identical at 375, 820 and 1440 px
Scenario: The scaler is gone
  Given the repository after the change
  Then no scale tool and no scaled stylesheet remain
